source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The paired removals delete unsubscribedNewsgroupLines and optionLines storage. Fixed HandleNewsrcLine still parses subscribed groups and their read sets, but ignores options, unparsed and unsubscribed lines instead of keeping them for a later roundtrip. Review explains that the old attempt to share one newsrc file with other newsreaders is no longer a reason to retain this unused state. That scoped decision does not remove subscribed state or establish every writer contract. No NNTP or cross-reader test ran.
title: The newsrc parser no longer preserves unused cross-newsreader lines
